benchmark_entry.name: Knock-in/knock-out parity: barrier-in + barrier-out = vanilla
benchmark_entry.description: Knock-in plus knock-out equals vanilla (barrier parity).

code.lean:
import MathFin.BlackScholes.BarrierParity

open MathFin

/-- Knock-in plus knock-out equals vanilla (barrier parity). -/
theorem mf_barrier_parity {Ω : Type u} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (Q : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) (A : Set Ω) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (f : Ω → ℝ) (hf : MeasureTheory.Integrable f Q) : ∫ ω, f ω ∂Q = (∫ ω, knockInPayoff f A ω ∂Q) + (∫ ω, knockOutPayoff f A ω ∂Q) :=
  MathFin.integral_eq_knockIn_plus_knockOut Q A hA f hf
